definitions.FE-1: Immutability — no in-place modification of any frozen unit U01…U12.
definitions.FE-2: Reuse mandate — downstream bands consume the Band-11 realization by reference.
definitions.FE-3: Redefinition prohibition — no frozen construct, meta-class, or law is redefined.
definitions.FE-4: Additive extension — new service concerns extend above, never inside, the baseline.
definitions.FE-5: Supersession-only change — breaking change is a new artifact under ENG-000 control.
